finalText:
I merged the three duplicate CRM search reports into T-1052, which is now sev2, escalated and due 2026-03-17T12:40Z.

- **Merged:** T-1052, T-1053 and T-1054 all report the same CRM search 500 error from Revenue Ops. T-1052 is the earliest created, so it survives. T-1053 and T-1054 are now merged into it.
- **Left alone:** T-1055 (CSV export gives an empty file) is a different problem. T-1061 (search index rebuild) is an engineering tracking ticket, not a user report. T-1061 now links to T-1052 instead of T-1054.
- **Severity:** The merged ticket's impact is department, which the CRM matrix grades sev2. I raised it from sev3.
- **Deadline:** The ticket carries 12:40Z, the earliest deadline committed on any of the three tickets (T-1053's). That is earlier than T-1052's own 15:05Z. I applied it because the duplicates rule requires the earliest deadline in the set.
- **Assignment:** The matrix sends sev2 to the platform-primary rotation. I escalated T-1052 to E-101 Dana Whitfield, who is on call there at 12:40Z. This replaced E-202, the original assignee on T-1053.
- **Judgement call:** E-101 is outside business-apps, which owns CRM. I took the matrix's escalation routing to override the rule against handing a ticket to an engineer outside the owning rotation. The alternative was E-201, the business-apps engineer on call at 12:40Z. Say so if you'd rather have that.

I also left a comment on T-1052 recording all of this.
